name: Tenant
fields: name:S!, status:S!=active, created_at:TS!, updated_at:TS!, schema_version:N!=1
notes: 테넌트 설정; 물리 삭제는 retention 작업만

name: Membership
fields: user_sub:S!, role:Enum(viewer|editor|reviewer|admin)!, status:Enum(active|revoked)!, revision:N!=1
notes: 테넌트별 PK/SK unique; 모든 권한 검사에 사용

name: Session
fields: user_sub:S!, active_tenant_id:UUID?, encrypted_refresh_token:BIN!, csrf_hash:S!, expires_at:N!, revision:N!=1
notes: 로그인 때 생성, 8시간 절대 만료/30분 idle; TTL은 청소용

name: Document
fields: document_id:UUID!, company_id:UUID!, title:S!, document_type:Enum(sustainability_report|annual_report_section)!, latest_version_id:UUID?, deleted_at:TS?, revision:N!=1
notes: 회사·문서 logical entity; latest pointer 변경은 CAS

name: Upload
fields: document_id:UUID!, upload_id:UUID!, original_filename:S!, expected_size:N!, expected_sha256:SHA!, s3_quarantine_key:S!, status:Enum(pending|validating|accepted|rejected|expired)!, expires_at:N!
notes: 원본 파일명은 표시용, S3 key는 서버가 생성

name: DocumentVersion
fields: version_id:UUID!, s3_key:S!, s3_version_id:S!, sha256:SHA!, size_bytes:N!, page_count:N!, company_id:UUID!, report_year:N!, industry_code:S?, industry_system:Enum(gics|sasb|custom|unknown)!, consolidation_scope:S?, statement_period:Map!, rights_profile_id:UUID!, status:S!
notes: 파일 bytes와 metadata snapshot 불변; 수정은 새 버전

name: Run
fields: run_id:UUID!, document_version_id:UUID!, mode:Enum(disclosure|advertising)!, scope:Enum(full|declared_subset)!, selected_pages:L<N>?, rule_pack_id:UUID!, rule_pack_sha256:SHA!, parser_profile_hash:SHA!, model_binding_hash:SHA!, status:Enum(queued|running|partial|completed|failed|cancelled)!, mutation_epoch:N!=0, revision:N!=1, counters:Map!, manifest_ref:ArtifactRef?
notes: epoch은 claim/tag/decision/head와 같은 transaction에서 증가

name: StageJob
fields: job_id:UUID!, input_hash:SHA!, stage:S!, shard:S!, status:Enum(pending|leased|succeeded|failed|cancelled)!, attempt:N!=0, fencing_token:N!=0, lease_owner:S?, lease_until:N?, heartbeat_at:TS?, artifact_ref:ArtifactRef?, error_code:S?
notes: 동일 stage/shard/input hash unique. worker conditional write 필수

name: Outbox
fields: event_id:UUID!, event_type:S!, payload_ref:ArtifactRef?, job_id:UUID!, status:Enum(pending|sent)!, next_attempt_at:N!, attempts:N!=0
notes: GSI queue bucket=OUTBOX#{hash(event_id)%16}, due_at 정렬

name: Claim
fields: claim_id:UUID!, source_ref:ArtifactRef!, claim_artifact_ref:ArtifactRef!, track:S?, head_tag_revision:N?, head_decision_revision:N?, review_status:Enum(auto_confirmed|needs_review|human_confirmed|ai_delegated_confirmed)!, decision_status:S!, revision:N!=1
notes: 원문과 전체 배열은 S3; 목록에 필요한 필드만 inline

name: TagRecoveryAuthorization
fields: schema:S!=tag_recovery_plan_v1, recovery_job_id:UUID!, lineage_job_id:UUID!, lineage_checkpoint_sha256:SHA!, shard:S!, receipts_root:S!, claim_ids:L<UUID>!, reissued_request_ids:L<UUID>!, acknowledged_failures:L<UUID>!, max_new_requests:N!, proof_sha256:SHA!, authorized_by:S!, authorized_at:TS!
notes: immutable; 중단된 tag stage 재개를 사용자가 승인한 범위에서 실행 주체가 명시 기록한 승인. 기존 stop/receipt/ledger/revision 을 바꾸지 않고 새 job 으로 never_sent 요청만 재발행한다. max_new_requests 는 job 단위 총량이며 재시작 시 baseline 대비 durable 하게 재계산한다. compat: DDL 없는 추가 전용 record kind. 활성 recovery job은 복구를 이해하는 새 worker만 소비해야 한다. rollback: 먼저 worker를 중지하고 활성 recovery outbox/job을 기존 worker가 소비하지 못하도록 격리한 뒤 이전 버전으로 전환한다. 승인·근거·ledger·stop·완료 revision은 삭제하지 않는다. 새 승인 생성을 끄는 것만으로 이미 enqueued된 job이 안전해지는 것은 아니다. 같은 lineage_checkpoint_sha256 에 대해 job 이 pending/leased 인 authorization 은 하나만 존재할 수 있고, 이 검사는 record 기록과 동일 transaction 에서 수행한다(TAG_RECOVERY_ALREADY_PENDING). 같은 recovery_job_id 재기록도 거부한다(TAG_RECOVERY_ALREADY_AUTHORIZED).

name: TagRecoveryProof
fields: schema:S!=tag_recovery_proof_v1, attempts_total:N!, classes:Map!, class_counts:Map!, receipt_counts:Map!, stop_records:Map!, durable_failures:Map!, baseline_request_ids:L<UUID>!
notes: immutable; 승인 시점 ledger·receipt 트리에서 다시 계산한 과금 증거. never_sent 는 receipt 디렉터리 부재 + 명시 suppression code + provider_request_id/token 없음 + Decimal 0 비용을 모두 만족해야 한다. baseline_request_ids 가 재시작 후 이 job 의 자체 사용량을 세는 기준이다. compat/rollback: 추가 전용 record kind.

name: TagRun
fields: packet_sha256:SHA!, replicate_id:Enum(1|2|3)!, request_signature:SHA!, raw_ref:ArtifactRef!, guarded_ref:ArtifactRef?, status:S!, provider_request_id:S?, usage:Map!
notes: 같은 replica의 재시도와 다른 replica를 구분

name: TagRevision
fields: tag_revision:N!, packet_sha256:SHA!, elements_ref:ArtifactRef!, source_hash:SHA!, origin:Enum(consensus|human|ai_delegated)!, reviewer_sub:S?, review_reason:S?, created_at:TS!
notes: immutable; 사람이 변경해도 기존 revision 유지

name: DecisionRevision
fields: decision_revision:N!, tag_revision:N!, rule_pack_sha256:SHA!, engine_version:S!, semantic_hash:SHA!, evidence_grade:Enum(E0|E1|E2|E3)?, label:Enum(SUBSTANTIATED|INCOMPLETE|UNSUBSTANTIATED)?, sublabel:Enum(PERF|IMPL)?, decision_status:S!, artifact_ref:ArtifactRef!
notes: 완전 decision은 S3, 조회 필드 inline; null은 미산출

name: Review
fields: review_id:UUID!, claim_id:UUID!, status:Enum(open|resolved|superseded)!, revision:N!=1, reason_codes:L<S>!, base_tag_revision:N!, resolved_by:S?, resolved_at:TS?, resolution_ref:ArtifactRef?
notes: review_id locator도 같은 transaction 생성; 낡은 태깅 기준 확정 금지

name: RulePack
fields: rule_pack_id:UUID!, artifact_ref:ArtifactRef!, sha256:SHA!, ontology_version:S!, version:S!, effective_date:Date!, mode:S!, status:Enum(draft|validated|active|retired)!, approved_by:S?, approved_at:TS?
notes: 루브릭 콘텐츠 불변; 상태/활성 pointer만 revision CAS

name: ExportSnapshot
fields: export_id:UUID!, snapshot_epoch:N!, claim_revision_refs:L<ArtifactRef>!, state:Enum(queued|building|ready|failed)!, format:L<S>!, manifest_ref:ArtifactRef?, partial:BOOL!, errors:L<S>!
notes: 대량 revision 목록은 S3 snapshot manifest로 옮김

name: UsageLedger
fields: request_id:S!, attempt:N!, role:S!, model_id:S!, input_tokens:N?, output_tokens:N?, cache_read_tokens:N?, latency_ms:N!, cost_decimal:S?, pricing_snapshot_id:S?, status:S!
notes: 실패·재시도도 기록; 가격 없음=null

name: Idempotency
fields: request_hash:SHA!, response_status:N!, response_ref:ArtifactRef?, response_inline:Map?, resource_id:UUID?, expires_at:N!
notes: 24시간 같은 키+다른 body409; 인증정보는 hash 입력 제외

name: ArtifactPointer
fields: artifact_id:UUID!, kind:S!, ref:ArtifactRef!, schema_version:S!, content_sha256:SHA!, status:S!
notes: SourceArtifact/ParseManifest/Observation/IndexEntry/AssuranceStatement/EvidencePacket/CheckResult/Comparison/SafeHarborRecord/Evaluation의 통일 metadata 저장

name: DeletionRequest
fields: deletion_id:UUID!, status:Enum(requested|running|blocked_retention|completed|failed)!, manifest_ref:ArtifactRef!, requested_by:S!, requested_at:TS!, completed_at:TS?
notes: 삭제되지 않은 version/cache/index가 있으면 completed 금지

name: AuditEvent [Audit table]
fields: sequence:N!, event_id:UUID!, actor_sub:S!, action:S!, target_id:S!, before_hash:SHA?, after_hash:SHA!, previous_event_hash:SHA?, event_hash:SHA!, timestamp:TS!, reason:S?
notes: HEAD record와 CAS 동시 기록, append-only IAM

name: Company
fields: company_id:UUID!, legal_name:S!, registration_identifier:S?, aliases:L<S>!, revision:N!=1, created_at:TS!, updated_at:TS!
notes: Same-tenant existence required before Document creation; names alone do not merge entities.

name: ApprovedProfile
fields: id:UUID!, kind:Enum(rights|consent|runtime)!, status:S!, version:S!, artifact_ref:ArtifactRef!, sha256:SHA!, approved_by:S?, approved_at:TS?
notes: RightsProfile/ConsentProfile/RuntimeBinding metadata; API emits only non-secret choices.
